properties.description: Slice 2. A radius that reaches a mirrored node says which design that node belongs to (its rows carry the design), and names the members to continue in, following part_of up and down and uses across. The /hub skill carries the radius on and reports every design it reached. Builds the open dec:idea-a-blast-radius-says-where-it-leaves-its-design-and-a-hub-carries-it-on on the recorded relation.
properties.name: A cross-design ripple follows each member's recorded relation and names the design each result belongs to and the one to continue in
